name: Biotech Pre-Launch to Phase II (UK/EU)

pain_points: Fixed deadlines (launch plan, congress cadence) with small teams
Static assets everywhere (slide decks, PDFs, webinars) with weak engagement data
Insight arrives too late to iterate content fast enough
No evidence that target HCPs understand clinical story and can apply it
Knowledge gaps by segment/market/role are invisible
Cannot justify what worked or where to focus next
buying_signals: Approaching Phase III or pre-launch stage

fit_logic.proceed: They have a defined launch cadence and need measurable readiness, not another content dump
fit_logic.park: They like 'insight' but cannot name an owner, timeline, or success metric
fit_logic.stop: They are buying reach only (paid media, list growth) or want an internal LMS replacement

what_they_do: Prepare HCP education and readiness for launch milestones (pre, during, post)
Run investigator and early HCP programmes (meetings, webinars, case-based education) with limited internal delivery bandwidth
what_they_sell: They do not sell education. They sell adoption of a therapy and strong clinical use in the real world. Internal driver is launch success and risk reduction (medical + commercial alignment).
what_proof_means: Evidence that target HCPs understand the clinical story, can apply it, and confidence is moving in the right direction. Evidence of where decision risk and knowledge gaps sit by segment, market, or role. Material that supports internal justification (what worked, where to focus next, what to change).
yoke_strengths: Speed: convert existing assets into interactive journeys fast, then reuse across channels and markets
Proof: confidence shift, decisions, gaps, engagement heatmaps, benchmark cuts
Governance: controlled updates, audit trail, approvals
Always-on loop: pre, during, post touches that keep engagement alive between moments
yoke_weaknesses: If they have no cadence and no plan to run any repeatable programme, insight does not compound
If internal policy blocks external platforms and they will not allow a compliant workaround

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps pre-launch biotech teams prepare HCPs faster with measurable readiness—converting existing assets into interactive learning that reveals confidence gaps and decision risks before launch.

pain_to_platform_to_outcome.pain: Fixed launch deadlines with static assets and no visibility into HCP readiness gaps
pain_to_platform_to_outcome.platform: 48-hour asset conversion + confidence scoring + decision pathways + governance
pain_to_platform_to_outcome.outcome: Measurable HCP readiness, visible gaps by segment, faster iteration, launch risk reduction

key_benefits: Convert slide decks and webinars into interactive case-based learning within 48 hours
Measure HCP confidence shifts and identify decision risks by market/segment
Reuse content across congress prep, advisory boards, and field team training
Maintain always-on engagement between launch milestones
Justify medical strategy with evidence of what worked and where gaps remain
messaging.elevator_pitch: Pre-launch biotech teams face fixed deadlines and need HCP readiness, not static content dumps. Yoke converts your existing assets into interactive learning that measures confidence, reveals gaps, and lets you iterate fast—so you launch with evidence, not guesswork.
messaging.outreach_angle: Quick question on HCP readiness measurement and launch risk visibility for Phase II/III programmes

disqualify_filters: Pre-clinical only with no near-term launch

unknowns: Typical budget bands for pre-launch readiness programmes by company size
Buyer and sign-off pattern across Medical Affairs vs Commercial in smaller biotechs

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase launch success probability with measurable HCP readiness and gap visibility
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce content production time and team bandwidth pressure

research_requirements.funding_stage: Track Series B+ funding, partnerships, IPOs
research_requirements.hiring_signals: Track medical affairs and launch team hiring
